item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.4 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.4 Preview
- Fixes the Mac update warning saying Clean Sweep cannot be updated from its download location and asking you to move it into Applications. - The companion stays inside `RemovalQueue.lrplugin`. Update checks now use its original installed location when macOS launches a temporarily relocated copy. - Signed-feed verification, the direct **Download** button, Later, and Skip This Version remain in place. No quarantine flags or macOS security settings are changed.
If your current version shows the location warning, download this ZIP manually once. Finish or stop your batch, close the floating window, replace the complete `RemovalQueue.lrplugin` folder, and reload it in Plug-in Manager. Your saved queue, photo edits, and preferences remain intact.
The fix passed regression testing with the real Sparkle updater on a read-only test volume, including rejection of a tampered feed. Live Lightroom update interaction remains a manual acceptance check.
